queries.search_text: site:podatki.gov.pl KSeF obowiązkowy 2026 terminy mikroprzedsiębiorcy faktury official
queries.source_title: Zakres obowiązkowego KSeF - KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur)
queries.proposition: The Polish Ministry of Finance states that KSeF authenticates users and delegated entities, mandates receipt from 1 February 2026, phases mandatory issuance, supports invoice attachments for complex billing, provides a VAT RR path, and connects B2G PEF invoices to KSeF.
queries.status: SUPPORTED FOR REGULATORY MECHANISM; WILLINGNESS TO PAY UNKNOWN
queries.contradiction: The source confirms obligations and special workflows but gives no failure-rate, buyer-budget, or vendor-demand evidence; the temporary small-seller threshold narrows immediate urgency for the smallest firms.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Show a manual exception report to five operators in each niche and ask each to pay for one live invoice batch before building an integration.

queries.search_text: site:environment.ec.europa.eu revised Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive extended producer responsibility pharmaceuticals cosmetics 2025 official
queries.source_title: New rules for more thorough and cost-effective urban wastewater management enter into force
queries.proposition: The European Commission says revised wastewater rules cover agglomerations from 1,000 inhabitants, require micropollutant and health monitoring, place at least 80% of advanced-treatment cost on pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, require stormwater planning, and promote phosphorus recovery.
queries.status: SUPPORTED FOR EU-LEVEL OBLIGATION; NATIONAL IMPLEMENTATION AND PAYMENT UNKNOWN
queries.contradiction: The source describes EU requirements and expected benefits, not Poland's final implementation, allocation formula, procurement calendar, or customers' current readiness to buy.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Obtain one paid scoping engagement from a Polish utility, municipality, or affected producer contingent on its counsel confirming the relevant implementation duty.

concepts.title: KSeF Missing-Invoice Sentinel for Independent Pharmacies
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A read-only exception service reconciles KSeF receipts against wholesaler deliveries and pharmacy stock so an owner catches missing, duplicated, or misassigned invoices before payment and close.
concepts.customer: Polish independent pharmacies and small pharmacy groups
concepts.loss_event: A supplier invoice is missed or posted to the wrong entity, creating late payment, duplicate payment, or an inventory and tax mismatch.
concepts.payer: Pharmacy owner or group finance lead
concepts.beneficiary: Pharmacy owner, bookkeeper, and purchasing staff
concepts.authority_holder: The pharmacy taxpayer who grants scoped KSeF access
concepts.distributor: Pharmacy accounting bureaus and regional pharmacy software integrators
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed-fee reconciliation of one month's KSeF invoices against delivery and stock exports
concepts.acquisition_route: Partner with two pharmacy-specialist accounting bureaus and sell through their existing client reviews.
concepts.compounding_asset: A library of wholesaler identity, document, credit-note, and mismatch patterns
hypotheses: Independent pharmacies can provide lawful read-only invoice and inventory exports.
Avoided reconciliation labor or payment errors justify a recurring fee.
Accounting bureaus will distribute a product that reduces close-time exceptions.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not access patient records, infer patient purchases, or use broader KSeF permissions than reconciliation requires.

concepts.title: VAT RR Authorization Desk for Produce Buyers
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A managed workflow helps dairies, mills, and produce processors collect farmer authorizations, validate master data, and issue auditable KSeF VAT RR documents without chasing paper.
concepts.customer: Polish agricultural processors and buying cooperatives purchasing from flat-rate farmers
concepts.loss_event: A missing authorization or malformed VAT RR document delays settlement and forces finance staff to repair records manually.
concepts.payer: Processor finance director or cooperative management board
concepts.beneficiary: Accounts payable staff, procurement staff, and supplying farmers
concepts.authority_holder: The farmer granting authorization and the buyer taxpayer issuing the document
concepts.distributor: Agricultural accounting firms, ERP resellers, and producer associations
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid onboarding of one supplier cohort and its first VAT RR issuance run
concepts.acquisition_route: Recruit one agricultural ERP reseller near Wielkopolska to introduce the service during KSeF migration work.
concepts.compounding_asset: Reusable authorization status, supplier-validation, and exception-playbook data
hypotheses: Buyers face meaningful manual effort across large farmer supplier lists.
Farmers will complete a simple assisted authorization flow.
Processors will pay for fewer blocked settlements and cleaner audit evidence.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not fabricate farmer consent, backdate authorization, or present software output as tax advice.

concepts.title: KSeF Permission Monitor for Bailiff Offices
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A minimal-access monitor inventories KSeF permissions, detects stale mandates and staff changes, and produces an evidence pack for small bailiff offices handling invoices in legally unusual roles.
concepts.customer: Polish court bailiff offices and small enforcement-office networks
concepts.loss_event: A departed employee, invalid mandate, or wrong entity permission blocks invoice handling or leaves excessive access in place.
concepts.beneficiary: Office owner, administrator, and external accountant
concepts.authority_holder: The taxpayer or enforcement authority empowered to grant KSeF permissions
concepts.distributor: Accounting and IT providers specializing in legal and enforcement offices
concepts.risk_bearer: The bailiff office and relevant authority holder
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid permission inventory and remediation report after a staff or mandate change
concepts.acquisition_route: Offer a white-label quarterly check through specialist accounting firms serving bailiffs.
concepts.compounding_asset: A ruleset of role, mandate, revocation, and least-privilege failure patterns
hypotheses: Small offices lack an internal access-governance process.
Staff and mandate changes create recurring permission risk.
Specialist accountants can reach enough offices without broad networking.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not impersonate an authority holder, retain signing credentials, or automate permission changes without explicit approval.

concepts.title: Complex-Usage Invoice Attachment Validator
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A preflight engine checks whether energy, telecom, and fuel usage rows in optional KSeF attachments reconcile to the structured invoice before a high-volume billing run is submitted.
concepts.customer: Mid-sized municipal utilities, fuel distributors, and telecom resellers with complex usage billing
concepts.loss_event: A mismatch between invoice totals and detailed usage causes rejection, customer disputes, or an expensive rebilling cycle.
concepts.beneficiary: Billing, finance, customer service, and downstream business customers
concepts.distributor: Billing-system integrators and municipal IT vendors
concepts.first_paid_event: Validation of one production-sized invoice batch before submission
concepts.acquisition_route: Sell a fixed-scope batch preflight through integrators already implementing KSeF connectors.
concepts.compounding_asset: An anonymized catalogue of tariff, unit, rounding, and attachment-to-header failure signatures
hypotheses: Complex usage attachments generate errors not caught by generic schema validation.
A read-only preflight can run without replacing billing software.
Avoided rebilling cost supports per-batch or recurring payment.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not alter invoices silently, invent metering data, or treat optional attachment use as universally mandatory.

concepts.title: PEF-to-KSeF Payment Delay Diagnostician
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A case-based service traces public-sector invoices across PEF, KSeF, purchase-order, and acceptance references to identify the specific defect holding up a contractor's payment.
concepts.customer: Small contractors and service vendors selling to Polish public entities
concepts.loss_event: An accepted public-sector job remains unpaid because invoice identifiers or workflow states do not reconcile across systems.
concepts.authority_holder: The contractor taxpayer and public buyer controlling acceptance and payment
concepts.distributor: Public-procurement advisers, factoring brokers, and contractor accountants
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed fee for diagnosing one overdue B2G invoice, with no contingent collection claim
concepts.acquisition_route: Receive referrals from factoring brokers when an otherwise valid public receivable cannot be funded.
concepts.compounding_asset: A decision tree linking status combinations and reference defects to resolution steps by buyer type
hypotheses: Cross-system reference defects are a material source of public-payment delay.
Contractors can lawfully share case metadata under a narrow mandate.
Factoring brokers have an incentive to refer blocked but financeable receivables.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not impersonate the supplier, pressure public officials improperly, or promise payment where the underlying claim is disputed.

concepts.title: Micropollutant EPR Cost Allocation Ledger
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A neutral ledger helps pharmaceutical and cosmetics producers verify product volumes, allocation inputs, exemptions, and treatment-cost charges before paying into a national wastewater EPR scheme.
concepts.customer: Small and mid-sized pharmaceutical and cosmetics producers selling in Poland
concepts.loss_event: A producer overpays, under-accrues, or cannot defend its allocated share of advanced wastewater-treatment costs.
concepts.payer: Producer finance or regulatory affairs director
concepts.beneficiary: Producer finance, compliance, auditors, and the collective scheme administrator
concepts.authority_holder: The national implementing authority and authorized EPR scheme
concepts.distributor: Pharma regulatory consultancies, cosmetics associations, and environmental-law firms
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid shadow calculation using one year's product and sales data
concepts.acquisition_route: Offer a confidential readiness calculation through industry associations before the Polish allocation method is final.
concepts.compounding_asset: A versioned product-classification, exemption, allocation, and dispute-evidence knowledge base
concepts.mechanism_class: REGULATORY COST ALLOCATION AND AUDIT TRAIL
hypotheses: Polish implementation will create producer-level data and payment duties.
Smaller producers lack systems for defensible allocation inputs.
A shadow calculation is valuable before invoices from a scheme arrive.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not advise evasion, misclassify products deliberately, or claim the EU announcement defines Poland's final allocation formula.

concepts.title: Wastewater Sample Chain-of-Custody Exchange
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A scheduling and evidence layer coordinates accredited laboratories, couriers, and treatment plants so micropollutant, PFAS, and health-monitoring samples remain timely, traceable, and procurement-ready.
concepts.customer: Municipal wastewater utilities and regional laboratory networks
concepts.loss_event: A missed sampling window, broken custody record, or unusable result forces resampling and leaves a compliance evidence gap.
concepts.payer: Wastewater utility laboratory or compliance manager
concepts.beneficiary: Utility management, laboratories, regulators, and public-health teams
concepts.authority_holder: The competent regulator and utility laboratory owner
concepts.distributor: Accredited environmental laboratories and water-sector engineering firms
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid coordination run for one scheduled sampling campaign
concepts.acquisition_route: Start as a white-label logistics layer for one accredited lab serving several smaller plants.
concepts.compounding_asset: A network-performance dataset of analytes, holding times, routes, rejection causes, and lab capacity
concepts.mechanism_class: CHAIN OF CUSTODY AND CAPACITY COORDINATION
hypotheses: New monitoring expands coordination load beyond current utility processes.
Accredited labs will expose capacity and rejection metadata.
Utilities will pay to reduce invalid samples and emergency resampling.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not fabricate custody records, substitute unaccredited analysis where accreditation is required, or expose identifiable health data.

concepts.title: Stormwater Plan Evidence Builder for Small Municipalities
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A data service turns rainfall, overflow, land-cover, and intervention records into a prioritized evidence pack that smaller municipalities can hand to engineers drafting mandatory risk-triggered stormwater plans.
concepts.customer: Polish municipalities and wastewater companies in smaller urban agglomerations
concepts.loss_event: A municipality commissions an expensive plan with weak evidence, misses a risk hotspot, or cannot justify which interventions deserve funding.
concepts.payer: Municipal infrastructure department or wastewater utility
concepts.beneficiary: Municipal engineers, residents in flood-prone areas, and plan authors
concepts.authority_holder: Municipal government and competent environmental authority
concepts.distributor: Civil-engineering consultancies and regional municipal associations
concepts.risk_bearer: The municipality and its wastewater operator
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed-fee evidence sprint for one catchment before the engineering tender scope is finalized
concepts.acquisition_route: Partner with one engineering consultancy that lacks an economical data package for small municipalities.
concepts.compounding_asset: A reusable Polish catchment feature store linking overflow evidence, interventions, tender scopes, and observed outcomes
hypotheses: Polish transposition will create plan work for identifiable smaller agglomerations.
Municipalities have fragmented but recoverable source data.
Engineering partners will buy or distribute a standardized evidence sprint.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not certify engineering safety, manipulate risk maps to favor a vendor, or claim a municipality is obligated before legal applicability is confirmed.

concepts.title: Sewage-Sludge Phosphorus Offtake Passport
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A quality and contract passport matches wastewater operators recovering phosphorus with fertilizer, installation, or materials buyers while preserving batch provenance and contaminant evidence.
concepts.customer: Wastewater operators evaluating phosphorus recovery and recovery-technology vendors
concepts.loss_event: A recovery project stalls because financiers cannot see a credible buyer, product specification, or defensible batch-quality history.
concepts.payer: Wastewater operator project sponsor or recovery-technology vendor
concepts.beneficiary: Operator, technology vendor, offtaker, and project financier
concepts.authority_holder: Wastewater operator and authorities governing recovered-material status and use
concepts.distributor: Water engineering firms, fertilizer advisers, and renewable-installation contractors
concepts.risk_bearer: The operator investing in recovery capacity
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid buyer-discovery and specification-matching dossier for one planned recovery project
concepts.acquisition_route: Use regional installation and engineering relationships to source one operator project and recruit buyers directly, without public-facing distribution.
concepts.compounding_asset: A dataset of batch specifications, contaminant tests, buyer acceptance criteria, logistics costs, and fulfilled offtakes
hypotheses: The recovery requirement creates projects whose financing depends on credible offtake.
Recovered phosphorus can meet lawful product or end-of-waste conditions in target uses.
Operators or vendors will pay before construction for verified buyer evidence.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not market sludge-derived material without required approvals, conceal contaminants, or guarantee offtake absent a signed buyer commitment.
